name: Threat Guard
short_description: Wallet risk, phishing domain and risky approval screening for EVM addresses
description: Security screening agent for the EVM ecosystem. Checks any wallet address for scam and sanctions exposure (cybercrime, money laundering, mixer use, malicious contracts created, phishing activity), verifies whether a domain is a known phishing site, and surfaces phishing risk indicators for a URL. Returns plain-text risk reports with the individual GoPlus security flags so you can judge severity yourself. Built for traders and deployers who want to vet a counterparty, a contract, or a link before interacting with it.
